label: fact
about: Airline aircraft adsb.lol's community receivers saw around Lisbon (40 nm) and Madeira (30 nm), 2026-11-12 05:00 to :59 UTC, one snapshot every 10 minutes for Lisbon and every 20 for Madeira. Airline flights only (an airline's ICAO code plus a flight number); every other aircraft is dropped and only counted. Fact: what adsb.lol shows at the time read; position_age_s says how old each position is. The wider areas, every 5 minutes, with the other aircraft as anonymous positions: frames/<area>/<date>/<HH>.json. Not the storm's peak: these start on 11 November at about 22:25 UTC (adsb.lol's daily history archive for 11 November is not out yet).
not_a_warning_service: Not a warning service. No forecast or advice of ours. Your airline decides whether your flight runs: its site or app has the latest. For warnings follow IPMA and ANEPC.
